name: Crimes of Passion
source:
A private detective. An exiled royal. A missing woman. Can you crack the case... without getting too close to your suspect?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Crimes_of_Passion,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
一名私家侦探。一个被流放的皇室成员。一个失踪的女人。你能在不与嫌疑人太接近的情况下侦破此案吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Crimes_of_Passion,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
